title: Austin Eyes Evictions, Transit & Displacement
summary:
*   The Regional Affordability Committee met to address key challenges facing Austin and the surrounding areas.
*   A major focus was on critical housing issues, including a briefing on evevictions in Central Texas and an update from the Anti-Displacement Task Force.
*   Attendees received an update on Project Connect, a significant regional initiative aimed at improving public transportation.
*   Citizens also had an opportunity to address the committee on general community concerns.
